title: CAGF-Net: Cross-Attention Gated Fusion of CT Imaging and Audiometric Signals for Cholesteatoma Detection
description:
Reference implementation of the paper A Reliable Neural Network Model Based on Cross-Attention Fusion of CT Imaging and Audiometric Signals for Cholesteatoma Detection (The 10th International Conference on Emerging Data and Industry, EDI 2027, Procedia Computer Science, Elsevier).

The software contains: (i) a reproducible hybrid simulation benchmark combining real NHANES 2015–2016 audiometric data with synthetic conductive pathology and a parametric temporal-bone CT phantom, including an artificial external domain; (ii) CAGF-Net with bidirectional cross-attention, gated fusion and modality-dropout, together with single-modality, Bayesian late-fusion and early-fusion baselines and ablations; (iii) temperature-and-shift calibration, Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty and selective prediction; (iv) evaluation with AUC/AP, ECE, Brier score, bootstrap confidence intervals and the DeLong test.

The CT component is a phantom and the pathology is synthetic; results constitute a simulation-based validation of the method, not clinical performance.
